name: english-auction
description: English Auction web app — monochrome Caliper UI over hosted-chain auction contracts

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c gray,white "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
